chok-yaakov/3:_: If they touch one another — and regarding tevilat kelim there is no concern; see Beit Yosef.
chok-yaakov/5:א: One may not kasher in any liquid — and same in water with ashes called lye; so Beit Yosef; see Pri Megadim Yoreh De'ah klal 58 s.k. 26 and Peri Chadash siman 95 s.k. 19 who ruled thus for law; therefore that hagalah done in homes in pewter vessel with white-hot stones with lye water is not proper hagalah; especially when done while dirty; and above siman 451 s.k. 67; therefore must be careful in those large vessels not inserted into pot — rinse them well with water alone — not as practiced with small pewter vessels.
chok-yaakov/5:ב: One may kasher no more — b'dieved permitted as in liquid; requires further study in Ran; Orach U'Mussar klal 58 din 72 that one may not use hagalah water of prohibition l'chatchila even if sixty against vessel because nullifying prohibition l'chatchila since wants to use the water.
chok-yaakov/6:א: A lip around its mouth with clay — and rest of year one makes lip for loading as chapter Kol HaShaah; Beit Hillel Yoreh De'ah siman 121 s.k. 1 wrote: see Rosh chapter Kol HaShaah — explicitly only regarding chametz on Pesach where heter absorption helps for large vessel lip; but regarding other prohibitions lip does not help for large vessel except need first hagalah once and afterward because of lip need lip; this only other prohibitions; but chametz on Pesach need not first hagalah once and afterward return and put boiling water with lip. But from Alfasi wording not implied thus chapter 2 Avodah Zarah cited Mar Ukva — they are equal regarding lip — end Bach; all his words puzzling here: one what wrote so implied Rosh explicitly chapter Kol HaShaah — examiner there sees no meaning in his words to distinguish thus; and hagalah twice why; and what mentioned there Rosh kasher pot twice — refers if kasher inside pot need kasher pot first and last as Mechaber above seif 1; see s.k. 8 see there explicitly as wrote; also what wrote but from Alfasi more puzzling for Rosh also wrote there thus; see beginning HaShocheir Et HaPoel — general matter no difference in this law only regarding lip for loading impossible on Pesach as Gemara and all poskim.
chok-yaakov/6:ב: And rise to its lip — but vessel whose use is from outside like bowl sometimes inverted on pot or vessel drawing from pot — outer side also needs hagalah; Magen Avraham in name of Maharil: vessel whose mouth narrow cannot scrub inside or has spouts — forbidden in hagalah — end.
peri-megadim/1:_: Before Taz in letter vav and Magen Avraham letter vav and Chokhmat Adam 1 letter tet — law that from fifth hour prohibition d'rabbanan like d'oraisa and not noten taam bar noten taam d'heter and requires sixty or not ben yomo regarding b'dieved; l'chatchila must be concerned in all matters — even not ben yomo and sixty not leave too long and not cease from boiling; until night noten taam lifgam and any amount forbidden during Pesach; however b'dieved if not careful in all these rely on law until night noten taam lifgam and any amount permitted; not so during Pesach any amount and noten taam lifgam forbidden b'dieved; for us may not kasher any vessel on Pesach and rely on taste busy not absorbing vessels and nature of water absorbs and does not expel — as we need to say there in letter bet at length.
peri-megadim/2:א: If Taz — before coming to explain Mechaber and Taz words I saw to speak somewhat on hagalah topic.
peri-megadim/2:ב: First one must investigate this hagalah — what its operation; for we have four ways: (1) to kasher vessel not ben yomo via lip; or in kosher pot; or per Abaye if vessel absorbed after expelling — noten taam lifgam and permitted; and we gain that initially absorbed was enhanced taste — originally decree lest ben yomo; not so now received impaired taste — l'chatchila Ran and other poskim and Peri Chadash brought them; from Rosh Pesachim 44 appears noten taam bar noten taam d'heter impaired taste to water and water to vessel and still heter; and so in responsum klal 14; and it seems initially in water and then to vessel — here one taste in vessel and impaired — still no heter for impairment not reached to disqualify from human food as Rashba wrote responsum 462, 463, 499 and Yoreh De'ah 95 — noten taam bar noten taam requires one taste in vessel and two in food; here one in food and two in vessel forbidden — somewhat difficult; and noten taam lifgam difficult how cook afterward sharp things like vinegar etc.; however noten taam bar noten taam before becomes sharp permitted as Yoreh De'ah from this; already challenged on this as said; Median vessel Torah forbade only ben yomo — therefore hagalah via way (2) as we need to say there (Kedoshim Aram Tzav); per view also taste returns and reawakens and noten taam lifgam also forbidden — difficult; and one may say all this noten taam lifgam noten taam bar noten taam they did not be stringent; see Olas Shabbat.
peri-megadim/2:ג: (2) To kasher in large kosher pot and sixty against vessel — as was in Median vessel; since intent to remove prohibition l'shem eino mevatelin; and R' Yehuda in its species in any amount — somewhat difficult how kashered Median vessel absorbed in libation waters for idolatry for kasher only in water; also how know what to use afterward perhaps its species; per view noten taam lifgam on Pesach forbidden — this difficult; Yoreh De'ah 226; one may say. Third way — leave only measure of expulsion and immediately remove — busy not absorbing; on this they challenged who is prophet to estimate this measure.
peri-megadim/2:ד: (4) Leave them and water raises boiling and water also absorbs and does not expel while raising boiling — therefore no concern vessels absorb from prohibition for water does not expel; Rashba rejected this responsum 462, 463, 456, 503 and Tosafot Chullin 108b s.v. shenafal see there. However we have fifth way — certainly ten handbreadths water absorbed in vessel and part prohibition from elevated water — see Tosafot there and 100b s.v. keshekadam; Magen Avraham brought it; if so no need sixty against any amount in dish afterward; Yoreh De'ah 99 seif 7; for law requires further study there; nevertheless in hagalah one may say on this; for us chametz nogeia l'shem zeh; however wet Beit HaMikdash permit therefore in hagalah we rely on this; if kasher second time better; Magen Avraham (see Zevachim 97a Rabbi and Sages — Sages rinsing after hagalah in hot second time Tosafot Chullin 100b s.v. keshekadesh; Rabbi rinsing and washing after hagalah in cold; if hagalah essence not mentioned — for Rabbi also not mentioned; Gemara knows they do not dispute thus — understand).
peri-megadim/2:ה: And here Rabbenu Yerucham emended that during Pesach may not kasher — holds only first two ways and fifth as said; Mechaber wrote when kasher before prohibition need not be particular way (1) not ben yomo for even ben yomo noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; Rabbenu Yerucham emended way (2) sixty; or way (3) particular in ben yomo not leave too long lest return and absorb ben yomo and no sixty and perhaps remove before expelling prohibition — and he said not leave much; and even if careful per measure of estimation still need warning not kasher vessels of equal absorption for otherwise expel vessels of slight absorption not busy and absorb from others if leave equal; if not diligent and know measure of expulsion and remove immediately need extra warning water not cease boiling for water expels and vessels absorb — difficulty here understand; and what wrote not insert vessels until water boils — difficult if afterward reboils and removed before ceased boiling permitted; Magen Avraham letter gimel; Olas Shabbat see there; shoots if ben yomo even vessels not ben yomo and sixty in water against them against pot — no; need pot hagalah first and last; not so before prohibition suffices end alone; for Magen Avraham fifth first or end see Taz 11; there explained; one may say Mechaber not word by word but said prohibition fit to purify in all matters as one counsel; also explain if leave much vessels absorb from hagalah water even raising boiling — after water full from absorbing expels even while boiling Tosafot Chullin 108b s.v. shenafal; Peri Chadash here; on this said even if careful and removed immediately per expulsion — warn water not cease boiling for otherwise vessels absorb from hagalah water; we do not say in vessels busy; on this Rama challenged proves hagalah helps without raising boiling; and he said see Levush seif 3 wrote not cease boiling — practice not insert vessel even before prohibition time for not expel all time not raising boiling; Beit Yosef permitted also this and holds impairs anyway and noten taam bar noten taam; Avodah Zarah there wondered; per what wrote no need; Levush holds after prohibition must not cease boiling measure there enough to expel; all the more not insert vessel without raising boiling; before prohibition anyway impairs water and noten taam bar noten taam — understand.
peri-megadim/3:_: That not Taz — appears explanation after time no remedy even if reboils afterward if inserted before boiling; already challenged Magen Avraham 3 and letter bet; and he said explanation when kasher pot first must be careful water not cease boiling and water does not expel at all and pot need not hagalah second time afterward; not so if cease need pot hagalah second time — great strain; see Tosafot Chullin 108b s.v. shenafal; one may say somewhat Avodah Zarah — understand.
peri-megadim/4:_: Until Taz 408 (Taz 429) and Magen Avraham there letter 11 — if forbidden on Yom Tov appears permitted to kasher for we prepare what cannot do from erev Yom Tov; difference on Yom Tov itself may not kasher for noten taam lifgam and any amount forbidden on Pesach; and heter busy or water does not expel while boiling — we do not hold thus; Magen Avraham challenged Mishna Berurah in Terumat HaDeshen brought siman 447 seif 10; for proven thus from Rashba. Light libun mentioned siman 451 like hagalah and preferable — nevertheless does not burn inside only expels — one may say forbidden on Pesach if absorbed treifah chametz via liquid or dry heat for possible returns and absorbs and not ben yomo does not help on Pesach for us. Siman 467 Taz letter 17 two any amounts wants to be lenient — some Acharonim agreed; if so appears vessel forbidden in any amount on Pesach b'dieved kasher in water — one may say if cooked in Pesach vessel — one may say in Beit HaMikdash why concern if returns and absorbs again two any amounts; however he said one in wet l'shem eino two any amounts as Pri Megadim Yoreh De'ah 92 letter 16 Taz obvious forbidden b'dieved; also per Aruch HaShulchan and Avodah Zarah siman 447:1 specifically piece no power in any amount to spread out — from vessel goes out; know otherwise vessel forbidden in any amount hagalah would not help — opposite explained; therefore even b'dieved forbidden dish cooked in it — we do not rely at all on heter busy or water does not expel for us. Vessel forbidden by smell and any amount and noten taam lifgam or dry in dry one in two absorbed in one in pot — three leniencies why concern if absorbed from water to vessel on Pesach Magen Avraham siman 447 letter 41; nevertheless may not kasher on Pesach not to distinguish and b'dieved does not forbid.
peri-megadim/5:_: Need Taz relies on what wrote letter zayin before prohibition l'chatchila rely on three noten taam d'heter; not so one; not so after prohibition time not ben yomo and no sixty how rely l'chatchila noten taam bar noten taam d'heter that noten taam lifgam permitted; or is difference between vessel first received enhanced taste versus first received impaired taste as Rosh Pesachim chapter Kol HaShaah per view and responsum klal 14 and Ran and Rashba responsum 464; nevertheless noten taam lifgam only b'dieved permitted; therefore reason there is branch vessel busy expelling perhaps does not absorb at all; or if absorbs noten taam lifgam and noten taam ner noten taam like that 464:1; therefore when kasher vessel twice certainly goes taste busy already expelled from one place and absorbs certainly and noten taam lifgam l'chatchila forbidden unless sixty in dish permitted for not nullifying prohibition l'chatchila — certainly on contrary intent to remove absorption; Chokhmat Adam letter 11; and what wrote no need; there letter 11 explained further.
peri-megadim/6:_: Before Taz see letter gimel and Magen Avraham 1 — in this prohibition d'rabbanan l'shem eino noten taam bar noten taam d'heter; libun burns all in libun sparks fly; hagalah remains something not ben yomo and noten taam lifgam any amount nevertheless absorbs from hagalah water — we do not rely on busy alone only branch there be doubt see letter heh.
peri-megadim/7:_: One of them Taz — b'dieved certainly permitted in one not ben yomo for noten taam bar noten taam d'heter even Rabbenu Yerucham Yoreh De'ah 95; nevertheless l'chatchila need heter noten taam bar noten taam three tastes via noten taam lifgam forbidden l'chatchila; answered not certainly only doubt perhaps absorbs perhaps not absorbs busy; if so b'dieved set aside; not so when kashering part of vessels twice and taste water does not expel while boiling — this is Tosafot Chullin 108b s.v. shenafal; already explained letter heh.
